dataset: EPVME malicious emails + Enron Spam ham

dataset_sources.name: sunknighteric/EPVME-Dataset
dataset_sources.license: GPL-3.0 repository license; source data includes collected and constructed malicious emails

dataset_form: public_research_corpora; exact normalized text duplicates removed

split.grouped_by: case-folded, whitespace-normalized exact subject and body

limitations: This is a cross-corpus research benchmark, not current real-world accuracy. EPVME includes constructed attacks and older collected messages; Enron ham is old non-spam mail, not independently verified as phishing-free. Source, time, language, and collection differences can inflate or reduce held-out scores. This near-perfect result is likely driven by source/corpus artifacts and is not evidence of near-perfect phishing detection. Campaign-aware and time-separated evaluation on recent labeled mail is still required.
